name: io.ceadigital/skip-trace-owner-phone-finder-python
title: Skip Trace & Property / LLC Owner Phone Finder + OFAC KYB MCP
description: Pierce anonymous real estate LLCs to human managing members, resolve verified wireless mobile phones & deliverable emails, geocode via U.S. Census, and run U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN & GLEIF LEI KYB checks.

tools.name: skip_trace_owner_phone_finder
tools.description: Pierce anonymous corporate LLCs or property owner names to identify the human managing member/registered agent, resolve verified wireless mobile phone numbers and deliverable emails, geocode the parcel via U.S. Census TigerWeb, and screen against U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN and GLEIF LEI KYB registries.

companyOrOwnerNames.description: List of anonymous LLC entity names or individual property owner names to pierce and skip-trace (e.g., ['PALMETTO INDUSTRIAL HOLDINGS LLC']).

addresses.description: Corresponding property street addresses, cities, states, and ZIP codes (e.g., ['1201 Main St Ste 1980, Columbia, SC 29201']).

reportType.description: Depth of enrichment: 'skip_trace_only' (phones/emails), 'pierce_llc_and_skip_trace' (adds SOS officer piercing + Census geocode), or 'full_kyb_guarantor_diligence' (adds GLEIF LEI + OFAC SDN sanctions screening).

includeLiens.description: Include tax delinquency, pre-foreclosure, and involuntary lien risk indicators when available.
